entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It's kinda hard to tell 'cause of how[n]dark it is... but is this Kamoshida too?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: This... is most likely a painting[n]of the ruler of this world.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Ruler? The hell're you talkin' about?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Quiet down. I don't want the[n]guards to notice us.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We should just focus on[n]escaping for now. Let's go!
There is a humongous self-portrait[n]hanging on the wall.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hey, don't get distracted by that thing.[n]We need to focus on getting out of here!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: What the...? Is this some kinda switch?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hey, don't go touching stuff.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Let's just concentrate on[n]reaching the exit.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We're not s'posed to be touchin' shit,[n]remember? Let's get outta here.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Uh, we don't got a reason[n]to be headin' back that way.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Let's just hurry our asses over to the exit.
We should head to the exit[n]instead of going back this way.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hey! Wait!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: There are still guards that way![n]Get back here if you don't want[n]to end up thrown in a cell again!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That's not the right way![n]Get back here!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hold on a sec!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: There are guards over there![n]The exit's in the other direction.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Ain't they gonna find us if we go[n]that way? C'mon, get back here.
